note: v10: no video. Each chapter is one scroll section on desktop (vh = min-height) and one DOM scene in the phone (public/assets/scenes.js). beats = what happens on the right, in order; the left copy marks its elements with data-beat="n".

chapters.label: Automatisierung

chapters.label: Postfach

chapters.label: Über uns

URL tippt sich in die Adresszeile, danach tritt das Handy zurück
